objective_value: <float> Total weighted tardiness across all jobs in the chosen schedule.

schedule.job_id: <int> Identifier of the job whose schedule is being described.
schedule.completion_time: <float> Time at which the job finishes its last operation.
schedule.tardiness: <float> Amount by which the job's completion time exceeds its due date, or zero if on time.

operations.machine: <int> Machine on which this operation of the job is processed.
operations.start_time: <float> Time at which this operation begins processing on its machine.
